title: Add category filter to demo shop
request: Users must filter the demo catalog by category, including an all option and an empty state.

acceptance_criteria.text: Choosing a category shows only matching products.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Browser: Category=lighting showed Desk lamp and Paper shade only (2 products).

acceptance_criteria.text: Unknown or empty-match categories show the empty state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: node --test demo/catalog.test.js: unknown category returns []. Empty message exists in DOM; not reachable from current select options.
Browser load showed 5 products. Unit test: filterProducts(..., 'all') returns full list.
node --test demo/catalog.test.js — 4 passed; node --test test/*.test.js demo/*.test.js — 19 passed.
